notes.title: Demo is out!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Greetings! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]We are happy to announce that the [b]demo version of Gun Center Simulator is out right now![/b][/h3]
[h2][b]You can play it this moment by visiting our steam site 👇[/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3618220/Gun_Center_Simulator_Demo/

Expand your gun center to new heights, starting from simple equipment to selling powerful rifles!

After you tried out the demo, don't forget to leave your feedback for us to check out.
New content ideas, suggestions about gameplay, whatever you would want to be added, share away at our steam discussions. If you encountered bugs during the demo, we also prepared a separate discussion where you can inform us about it. 👇

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3618200/discussions/0/595150868109614391/][h3][b]📖 SUGGESTIONS & FEEDBACK[/b][/h3][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3618200/discussions/0/595150868109614392/][h3][b]🐛 BUGS & PROBLEMS[/b][/h3][/url]

Last thing, if you wanna share your experiences, talk about the game, be a part of the community even more, please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3618220/Gun_Center_Simulator_Demo/]WISHLIST[/url] our full game on steam and go visit our official Discord channel!

[url=https://discord.gg/vSVGVVQkcd][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594234/fe8d51452bef96ab16482d2693796c0ef9338f31.png[/img][/url]

See you on the shooting range!
